svg.title: Separate the profile solve from flow integration
svg.desc: The centered second difference is exact for a quadratic at grid nodes. Trapezoidal integration underestimates its flow by 1/N² for N equal intervals. The convergence plot measures quadrature error, not a claimed profile discretization order.
